This plot is small, only 0.06 hectares, so my family and I can manage the work ourselves without hiring anyone. I will apply some DAP and urea that I get through the cooperative, though the amount is never enough, and I will also put manure on the soil because we have a few animals. For seed, I will use what I saved from last year's harvest since improved sorghum seed is hard to find and expensive. I will not use chemicals or irrigation because this is rainfed sorghum and pesticides are too costly for such a modest crop.
